name: Initiator Pharma A/S
summary: Initiator Pharma A/S is a clinical-stage life sciences firm dedicated to discovering therapeutic solutions for critical unmet medical needs affecting the central and peripheral nervous systems. Its development pipeline features several clinical-phase compounds: IP2018, a monoamine reuptake inhibitor aimed at psychogenic erectile dysfunction; IPED2015, designed to address organic erectile dysfunction; and IPTN2021, an orphan drug candidate for severe neuropathic pain. Additionally, the company holds early-stage assets, including IPNP2015 for chronic pain management and IPDP2015 for depression. Established in 2016, Initiator Pharma A/S maintains its headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark.
